title: Earth Body-Fixed Root and Orientation Profiles
negative_results: a zero rotation axis or zero prime-meridian direction is rejected (OrientationError)
an unknown orientation profile key is rejected
a vector that is not three finite floats is rejected

claims.statement: The Earth body-fixed root fixes geocentre/rotation-axis/prime-meridian conventions with an optional crustal anchor; switching versioned OrientationProfile changes the ECEF mapping deterministically and the switch is recorded.
The orientation mapping is a pure rotation and is exactly reversible; profiles are versioned records, legacy versions retained.

runlog.inputs: none; orientation offsets and vectors passed in, no wall-clock read
runlog.assumptions: polar motion in arcsec, prime-meridian offset in degrees; identity profile is the identity rotation
runlog.boundary: public code, synthetic orientation profiles only
unresolved_questions: full IERS Earth-orientation-parameter time series and s' term are out of scope; static per-profile offsets only

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
